outcome.failing_consumer: 285800000.iommu bound to apple-dart already owns 0x285800000-0x285803fff, which lies inside the ANE engine resource 0x284000000-0x285ffffff
outcome.live_fdt_note: The test-boot ANE nodes remain in the immutable live FDT until the next boot. The module is removed and the next-boot DTB and boot.bin are restored to their exact pre-change hashes. A second reboot was prohibited and was not performed.

preconditions.decision: The source-built base differed from both installed stock DTBs outside ANE, so it was rejected. Only the ANE, DART, and required ANE CPU power-domain phandle were transplanted onto the stock DTB consumed by update-m1n1.
stock_to_enabled_semantic_diff: added phandle 0x109 to existing ANE power-controller /soc/power-management@28e080000/power-controller@2c8

update_m1n1.boot_image_construction: cat m1n1.bin and resolved DTBs, gzip u-boot-nodtb.bin, append filtered m1n1.conf

module.preflight_mistake: The first post-reboot insmod command named the pre-reboot /tmp module path before checking that the file survived reboot. It failed in userspace with ENOENT and did not reach a kernel consumer or probe. The exact source commit was then archived, rebuilt at the original path, hash-checked, and inserted once for the only kernel probe.
